notes.title: Morriton Manor Stories: Nordic Whispers Live Stream
notes.content:
About Morriton Manor Stories: Nordic Whispers
A mystery detective game with RPG elements. Cursed by demonic forces, a mysterious island is trapped in a time loop. Leah Glessner, Private Investigator of the Supernatural, uses her unique gift of photographic memory to confront evil. Skill your character. Investigate. Solve the case. 


Dev insights & gameplay
Marcus (Writing, Game Design, Programming), Matze (Art) and Hauke (Writing, Game Design) talk about the development of the game.

Watch the broadcast on the store page
